subject: Price clearance & commit timing — Mosaic Energy pilot
messages:
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@mosaicenergy.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Mosaic Energy Procurement <procurement@mosaicenergy.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot pricing question and timeline

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to move to a 3-month pilot. Before we lock dates we need final pricing confirmation and a short statement of work. Procurement has asked that any concession/discount that changes revenue recognition be cleared by your finance team and the deal desk.

Attached is our summary of expected usage and a short list of success criteria. Can Redwood confirm: 1) the net price after concessions, 2) whether Redwood will sign the standard PO language for a pilot, and 3) any minimum commit that would change how Mosaic should be reflected in your forecast?

We’re targeting Nov 8 for kickoff so procurement is on a tight cadence.

Thanks,
Evan

--
Evan Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships
Mosaic Energy
E: evan.cole@mosaicenergy.com
T: +1 415-555-0119

Attachments: mosaic_price_request_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@mosaicenergy.com>
Cc: procurement@mosaicenergy.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing question and timeline

Hi Evan — appreciate the clear summary and timeline.

Quick answers up front:
- We can offer the pilot at a 25% usage discount for 3 months (details in attached deal summary).
- Redwood will accept the standard pilot PO but need the clause on data deletion aligned with our SOC2 policy (I’ll attach the redline).
- Important for forecasting: because this concession reduces ARR prorated to the pilot, finance asks that any deal seeking commit recognition pass a deal-desk clearance so they can set the commit amount and timing.

I’m looping in Marcus (Deal Desk) and Karthik (Finance) to get an explicit clearance and timeline. If we can close approvals by EOD Oct 27, we can keep your Nov 8 kickoff and move the opportunity to Commit in HubSpot.

Action for Mosaic: please confirm you’ll accept the redline on data deletion and sign the attached PO.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once we have internal approvals.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
--
Attachments: deal_summary_RW-2026-0453.xlsx (Excel), mosaic_price_request_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Pilot pricing question and timeline

Folks — reviewing Evan’s ask and Vanessa’s note. Short summary from Deal Desk side:

- The 25% pilot concession is acceptable as a temporary promotional credit.
- If Mosaic requires that the pilot be treated as a recognized commit for Q4, Deal Desk needs a centralized exemption with Finance sign-off.
- Proposed clearance: allow pilot at 25% discount, but only recognize 50% of the expected ARR for forecasting purposes unless Finance signs off to recognize the full amount.

Karthik — can Finance confirm whether recognizing 50% is acceptable for Redwood’s forecast and what additional controls (e.g., PO receipt, signed SOW, or escrow of payment) you need to move this to Commit? This matters because our Q4 forecast is tight and several discounts are already queued.

I’ve attached a one-page deal summary for quick read.

Marcus Lin
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
--

Thanks — quick finance response and clearance.

- Finance approves the 25% pilot concession with the caveat that for forecast treatment we will recognize 50% of the expected monthly run-rate toward committed pipeline until the following are received: signed PO and signed SOW.
- If Mosaic provides an up-front payment or a purchase order explicitly stating pilot commitment, Finance will consider full recognition earlier; otherwise treat as At Risk.
- Please update HubSpot deal RW-2026-0453: Stage -> "Commit (conditional)"; Forecasted ARR -> set to 50% of proposed pilot ARR; Add note: "Deal Desk clearance 27-Oct-2026: finance to re-evaluate upon signed PO/SOW or prepayment."

Vanessa — please confirm once Mosaic accepts the redline and uploads signed PO. Marcus/Laura — I’m happy to review any final SOW language.

Karthik Iyer
